summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #39. Committed: (1) byte-identical parity corpus fixture from viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json (algorithm_version 1, sha256 7b7b4d904ff369e1f5be0ec3a994d96cc996056e856d86a2b764b83c050f8604) plus SolverParityCorpusTests replaying every scenario through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer AND CompositionSolver with exact score equality, tie evidence, exclusions and weight handling; (2) OpenAPIContractTests enforcing the committed OpenAPI document (Sources/ColorComposerCore/OpenAPI/openapi.json), Package.swift wiring of swift-openapi-runtime/OpenAPIGenerator, bearer scheme, and spec-vs-DTO property parity (intentionally red: deliverable not yet implemented); (3) PaletteAPIClientWireContractTests + OfflineFallbackIntegrationTests pinning the /api/v1 wire behavior, per-server/profile disk cache, offline-stale badge data and cached-profile fallback that the generated-client migration must preserve; (4) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md and docs/generated-openapi-client.md. Overall status 'failed' is the intended red-phase state: implementation deliverables (generated client, Package.swift wiring, README section, PR description) are out of scope for this run. IMPORTANT EXECUTION CAVEAT: this container has NO Swift toolchain (swift/swiftc not found; package targets macOS-only frameworks so a Linux toolchain could not build it either), so swift test could not be executed; parity assertions were instead verified by an exact-arithmetic Python oracle mirroring the Swift scorer/solver semantics 1:1 over the committed fixture (tmp/parity-oracle.py, output tmp/parity-oracle-output.txt: FAILURES: 0, exit 0), and the wire/offline tests only exercise existing public API pinned to current behavior. Lint/test commands per run config: 'No lint command configured' / 'No test command configured'.
